security_audit.summary: All 154 static detections are false positives involving Markdown formatting, reference links, documented token storage, or model-selection advice. One semantic risk concerns an unconditional shell-safety claim without guidance for safely quoting arbitrary prompts. No evidence found of malicious intent, credential exfiltration, or instructions to override the audit; the external CLI implementation was not provided.

remediation.issue: The shell-safety claim ignores shell parsing before the CLI receives prompt arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the unconditional claim with shell-boundary guidance. Use argument-array execution without a shell, or demonstrate correct shell quoting for apostrophes and hostile prompt text.

semantic_findings.title: Shell-Safety Assurance Omits Argument Quoting
semantic_findings.description: The claim 'No shell-injection surface from prompt content' ignores shell parsing before CLI execution. Interpolating arbitrary prompts into the single-quoted examples can allow apostrophes to terminate quoting and expose shell syntax.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples wrap JSON in shell single quotes, and the assurance gives no shell-escaping requirement. Exploitation depends on how an agent substitutes user text; no CLI implementation was provided.

content.value_statement: Choosing video models and input settings can slow creative work. This skill maps your request to RunComfy routes with model-specific prompts and CLI examples.
actual_capabilities: Select documented text-to-video, image-to-video, and Veo extension routes based on creative intent.
Prepare RunComfy CLI generation requests with model identifiers, JSON inputs, and a local output directory.
Provide prompt guidance for motion, camera direction, reference roles, and inline audio descriptions.
Configure Wan lip-sync examples using a user-provided audio URL.
Compare Kling quality tiers and identify faster model variants for iteration.
Explain documented CLI exit codes for input errors, authentication failures, and retryable conditions.
limitations: Requires the external RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and any applicable service charges.
Contains instructions only; model availability, rankings, output quality, and CLI security claims were not independently verified.
Inputs and duration limits vary by model; detailed extension workflows require the linked documentation or a separate skill.
Generation uses a remote service; arbitrary prompt text still requires safe shell argument handling.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved image URL [image URL] for a product rotation. Keep the camera fixed. Prepare a Veo request for review before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn approved product photography into a controlled motion request.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Match a Voiceover
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Wan lip-sync request using my approved audio URL [audio URL]. Describe a studio presenter. Confirm current input requirements before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a specific voiceover as the lip-sync input.

prompt_templates.title: Expert: Compare Production Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a cinematic campaign clip using my approved references [references]. Compare Seedance and Kling tiers. Check current schemas and costs. Await approval before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate reference handling and production tradeoffs before committing service usage.

output_examples.input: Choose a route for a presenter speaking to my existing voiceover.
output: Suggested route: Wan 2-7 text-to-video with an audio URL input.
Describe the presenter and scene in the prompt; use the approved voiceover file to drive lip motion.
Check audio access, current schema requirements, and authorization before submitting.

best_practices: Check the current model schema, service charges, and desired duration before approving a generation job.
Use only authorized reference assets and task-specific URLs; keep API tokens out of prompts and logs.
Pass prompt data as safely encoded arguments; do not assume JSON encoding alone makes shell interpolation safe.
anti_patterns: Treating static ranking claims or exact motion examples as guaranteed generation results.
Pasting untrusted prompt text into shell commands without correct argument quoting.
Submitting confidential references or starting paid jobs without user authorization.

faq.question: What must I install?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI and authenticate with your account. Review the documented package setup before running it.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It guides requests to the RunComfy Model API and documents downloading results to a local output directory.

faq.question: Can I animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes image-to-video routes and examples using an image URL supplied for the task.

faq.question: Can I synchronize a clip to my own voiceover?
faq.answer: The documented Wan route accepts an audio URL for lip-sync. Confirm current endpoint requirements and use audio you are authorized to process.

faq.question: Can it extend an existing video?
faq.answer: It identifies Veo extension endpoints. Detailed preparation and chained extension guidance are delegated to a separate skill.

faq.question: Are model quality and shell safety guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Model claims require current verification, and generated shell commands require safe argument handling before execution.
